label: D1 in early-episode trials (3-30) when the policy moderately favors a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2). Within D1 it needs three things: (1) the episode is early, trial 3 to about 40, peaking at trials 10-19; it never fires on trials 0-2 or after about trial 50; (2) the model policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) at that step is moderately negative, between about -4.4 and -1.5 (99% of mass), so the upcoming choice is a2 (about 99.9% of activations; 0 after a previous a1 choice); (3) the value output is in a middle band, 7.1-7.7. It leans toward episodes that start with S2 good (87% of mass), after a previous a2 that reached S2 by a common transition, and it is strongest at D1 after common-unrewarded a2 trials (the top windows are r0 after a2->S2c). It does not fire after a1 choices, after rare transitions, at strong a2 preference (logit < -4.4), or late in the episode. Precision is only about 0.3: many D1 steps that meet all of these conditions stay silent, so the episode-time window and the logit band are necessary but not sufficient. It looks like a slow, time-dependent integrator that is gated by a moderate a2 policy. Recorded predicate uses only observed quantities (episode time, the model own logit at the step).
